create_Converter: create a Converter instance with rows, columns, and ttyrec version for NetHack terminal recording conversion
load_ttyrec: load a .bz2 ttyrec file into the Converter using load_ttyrec to prepare for frame extraction
convert_frames: convert ttyrec data into numpy arrays of chars, colors, cursors, timestamps, actions, and scores
test_is_loaded: test whether the Converter has a ttyrec file loaded by calling the is_loaded method
test_buffer_validation: test that Converter.convert raises ValueError for mismatched array shapes or wrong dtypes
